verdict.rationale: Mistral has a first-party function-calling page: its models connect to user-defined functions and external local tools. Its Agents API also documents tool use with state persistence, which supports running an agent loop. The pack, however, never shows how tools are typed, whether parallel tool calls work, or how multi-step call sequences are handled, and no community report confirms tool calling is reliable. Missing for 10: typed tool-definition schema documentation, parallel tool-call support, multi-step call sequencing docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of tool-call reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on faithful function/tool calling — typed tool definitions, parallel and multi-step calls — documented well enough to run an agent loop on this model

citations.quote: Function calling, under the Tool Calling umbrella, allows Mistral models to connect to external local tools.
By integrating Mistral models with external tools such as user defined functions or APIs, users can build applications catering to specific use cases
AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
